sources.quote: CMHC's 2025 Rental Market Report found the national purpose built apartment vacancy rate rose to roughly 3 percent, up from about 2 percent a year earlier, as record completions arrived
sources.title: Canada’s vacancy rate rises amid historically high rental construction | CMHC
sources.evidence: Canada's vacancy rate for purpose-built rentals rose to 3.1% in 2025, up from 2.2% in 2024 and above the national 10-year average, driven by historically high rental unit completions and slower population and economic growth. Vancouver's vacancy rate reached 3.7%, the highest level since 1988.

sources.quote: In Ontario the Condominium Act requires a corporation to hold its annual general meeting within six months of fiscal year end
sources.title: Annual General Meetings - Condominium Authority of Ontario
sources.evidence: Condo corporations must hold their first AGM within three months of the condo being registered and within six months after the end of each fiscal year thereafter. Section 45 (2) of the Condominium Act requires that condominium corporations hold their AGM within six months of the end of the previous fiscal year.

sources.quote: The CAO states the registry is for personal use
sources.title: Condo Registry Search - Condominium Authority of Ontario
sources.evidence: The Condo Registry is a free, searchable online database of Ontario condo corporations showing address for service, number of voting units, board director names, management company and more. The Condo Registry can only be used for personal purposes; systematic or automated data collection activities are prohibited.

sources.quote: Alberta's condominium manager licensing took effect on December 1, 2021
sources.title: December 1, 2021 - Condo manager licences are now required | RECA
sources.evidence: Starting December 1, 2021, condominium management companies (brokerages) and individual condominium managers must hold a licence with the Real Estate Council of Alberta (RECA) to provide condominium management services.

sources.quote: the Ontario Human Rights Commission's rental housing policy is explicit about income criteria
sources.title: Policy on human rights and rental housing | Ontario Human Rights Commission
sources.evidence: It is illegal for housing providers to apply a rent-to-income ratio such as a 30% cut-off rule. Income information may be sought and considered only if the landlord also seeks and considers information about the prospective tenant's credit references and rental history.

sources.quote: Managed buildings are not eligible for their own profiles unless staffed by a rental office
sources.title: Business eligibility and ownership guidelines - Google Business Profile Help
sources.evidence: Rental or for-sale properties such as vacation homes, model homes, or vacant apartments are not eligible for a Google Business Profile. Sales or leasing offices, however, are eligible for verification.

sources.quote: because strata services run through a licensed brokerage under a managing broker
sources.title: Strata Management | BCFSA
sources.evidence: All strata managers provide services through licensed brokerages and are supervised by managing brokers who are responsible for the activities of the professionals at the brokerage. All services that require licensing under the Real Estate Services Act, including the provision of strata management services, must be provided through a brokerage.
